title: Product formula for a rectifiable set: Ψ_*(L¹⌞(0,1) ⊗ Hⁿ⌞M) = H^{n+1}⌞Ψ((0,1) × M) (parent step 5)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and M ⊆ ℝ^N be Borel, countably n-rectifiable, with Hⁿ(M) < ∞ (Hᵈ := μHE[d]). With Ψ(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))), the image under Ψ of (Lebesgue measure on (0, 1)) ⊗ (Hⁿ restricted to M) equals H^{n+1} restricted to M̃ := Ψ((0, 1) × M): Measure.map Ψ ((volume.restrict (Ioo 0 1)).prod (μHE[n].restrict M)) = μHE[n+1].restrict (Ψ '' (Ioo 0 1 ×ˢ M)).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid N)), MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable n M → μHE[n] M ≠ ∞ → Measure.map (fun p : ℝ × Euclid N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons p.1 (WithLp.ofLp p.2)) : Euclid (N + 1))) (((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioo 0 1)).prod (μHE[n].restrict M)) = μHE[n + 1].restrict ((fun p : ℝ × Euclid N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons p.1 (WithLp.ofLp p.2)) : Euclid (N + 1))) '' (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ M))
